note: Lower bounds on N(n), the number of mutually orthogonal Latin squares of order n, published after Table 3.87 of the Handbook of Combinatorial Designs (2nd edition, 2007; R. J. R. Abel, C. J. Colbourn and J. H. Dinitz), as found in the literature check of 15 Nov 2026. The Handbook table itself is read from SageMath's module sage/combinat/designs/MOLS_handbook_data.py (10,000 entries, with the two updates of J. H. Dinitz's website: N(60) >= 5, N(7968) >= 31). For n < 500 the current baseline is the 2024 compilation of A. Miller, R. J. R. Abel, I. Valkov and D. Fraser, Implementing the MOLS table for n up to 500, Symmetry 16 (2024) 1678, which notes improvements at 9 orders n < 120 since 2007 and corrects a few errors; its full table could not be read here (mdpi.com answers robots.txt with HTTP 403, and the University of Glasgow repository disallows our client in robots.txt), so cells with n < 500 are kept only where the current value is known from the papers below.
